sessions.name: Session A

summary: Two short sessions a week, added to a cardio day to make it a good day. Do 2–3 sets of 8–12 and stop with about two reps left in the tank. Each session takes about 20 minutes and works with dumbbells and a cable machine, so it carries over to an apartment gym.
title: Starter lifting: four moves
